summary: Changed Option.get_error_hint in src/click/core.py to only append the hint when show_envvar and envvar are truthy, treating a str as a one-item list, wrapping each variable in quotes, and joining with ", " plus an explanatory comment. Changed Option.get_help_extra so the auto-prefix name is used when envvar is falsy (merged the nested if into one condition) and extra["envvars"] is set only for a truthy envvar. Added two Unreleased bullets to CHANGES.md ending with {pr}`3884`. The check command `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_options.py` passed with 676 tests.
concerns: Confirm the comment wording about quotes (space/comma on every platform) matches expectations.
Verify non-str, non-list envvar types still format correctly via str().
